summary: Beyond Air filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing an employment agreement with CEO Robert Goodman, who was appointed effective March 27, 2026, but had no prior contract. The agreement has no fixed term, provides a minimum annual base salary of $650,000, a target bonus of 60% of salary (0%-150% payout), and eligibility for equity and fringe benefits. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were stated. This is a compensatory arrangement rather than a forced departure; watch for governance or turnover risk and dilution from future equity grants.
